rules.push: When your power helps a roll, take 1 Stress to roll with Advantage. Some abilities also cost Stress directly.
rules.strange_stress: The first time you use a strange power in a fight or scene, take 1 Stress. Pushing it costs the usual 1 Stress on top. Street powers have no use cost.
rules.always_on: Armored and Invulnerability are always on. Take the 1 Stress the first time the power stops a hit in a fight. They must take Allergy: while the weakness is present, their Toughness doesn't apply.
rules.street_source: Street powers are within peak-human reach. Write in a source.
rules.strange_cost: Strange powers are clearly superhuman. They cost 2 slots, and you must write in a cost and pick a flaw.

flaws.name: Allergy
flaws.text: Name a weakness (iron, salt, bright light, a sound). When it's present, the power is at Disadvantage. An always-on power that never rolls simply doesn't work against it. Villains who learn it can use it against you.

flaws.name: Unstable
flaws.text: On a Miss with the power, the GM makes a move and the power also misfires in a way that fits it. Most misfires should hit the scene rather than the team. When one does catch an ally, it's an Impact 1 hit on them.

flaws.name: Marked
flaws.text: The power shows on your body and you look like a monster. Being seen by civilians ticks Heat by 1, and Presence rolls with strangers are at Disadvantage until they get to know you.

abilities.name: Utility belt
abilities.text: You get Kit: pick 2 Kit items per Night (using one is a Quick Action, once per item per fight). A Specialist, who already has Kit, picks 5 instead of 3.

abilities.name: Built for this
abilities.text: Once per Night, reveal a gadget made for exactly this. The roll it helps is an automatic Impact 2.

abilities.name: Tinker
abilities.text: When you Patch Up at Dawn, also repair one broken piece of gear.

powers.name: Resilient
powers.note: Tough and quick to recover; formerly Healing Factor

abilities.name: Fast mender
abilities.text: A breather clears Bruised and Hurt.

abilities.name: Shake it off
abilities.text: Once per fight, Quick Action: clear one Harm box.

abilities.name: Not today
abilities.text: The first time you would die, you survive, out of action until the next Night. Then cross this off.

abilities.name: Strong like an ox
abilities.text: Edge on Force rolls to lift, break, hold, or throw, and your bare hands count as light melee.

abilities.name: Hurl
abilities.text: On a Strike hit, throw the target into an adjacent zone. If they land on another enemy, both take 1 Harm.

abilities.name: Hold the line
abilities.text: When you Interpose or shield someone, you get +1 Toughness against that hit.

abilities.name: Tough
abilities.text: Add one Harm box (Battered, between Hurt and Wounded), and you have Toughness 1 against fists and blunt weapons (not blades or bullets: it is grit, not magic). This doesn't stack with Toughness from Force +3 or from any other source: use your single highest.

abilities.name: I can take it
abilities.text: When you take Harm and stay on your feet, gain 1 Drive (once per round).

abilities.name: Won't stay down
abilities.text: Once per Night, when you would go Down, stay at Wounded instead.

powers.name: Enhanced Senses
powers.note: Loud noise, bright light, or strong smells can overwhelm you

abilities.name: Keen
abilities.text: Edge on Patrol rolls your sense helps, and Dark zones don't give you Disadvantage.

abilities.name: Nothing gets past you
abilities.text: You can't be ambushed, and Dark doesn't hide anyone from you.

abilities.name: On the trail
abilities.text: When someone gets away, roll Focus against 13. On a hit, you know where they went. On Impact 2+, also take a clue.

abilities.name: Uh oh
abilities.text: +1 Guard.

abilities.name: See it coming
abilities.text: When an attack hits you, take 1 Stress to make the attacker reroll.

abilities.name: See the future
abilities.text: When you miss, the GM offers two moves and you pick which happens.

abilities.name: That ain't a knife
abilities.text: Your weapon follows its gear rules, and your first attack each fight with it has Edge.

abilities.name: How's it feel?
abilities.text: On a hit with it, choose one: the target takes 1 Stress, or +1 Harm on Impact 2 or better.

abilities.name: This is a knife
abilities.text: Once per fight, take 1 Stress to reroll a missed attack with it.

powers.name: Quick
powers.note: Fast for a human; formerly Super-Speed

abilities.name: Fast
abilities.text: Your free move covers two zones.

abilities.name: Watch me
abilities.text: Edge on Flow rolls in a fight.

abilities.name: Burst
abilities.text: Once per turn, take 1 Stress for an extra Quick Action with Advantage.

abilities.name: Movement
abilities.text: Climbing and swinging never need a roll, and your free move can reach High Ground.

abilities.name: Combat
abilities.text: When your Jab hits, you can grab the target instead of hurting them: they can't move on their next turn.

abilities.name: Multi-tasking
abilities.text: Once per turn, take 1 Stress to do two Quick Actions with one roll.

abilities.name: Spark
abilities.text: You start every fight with 1 Charge, and touching live power is a Quick Action to regain it (max 1). Spend 1 Charge for Edge on a roll electricity helps.

abilities.name: Surge
abilities.text: Grab high voltage: roll Force against 13. On a hit, gain 3 Charge (max 3). On a miss, take 2 Harm.

abilities.name: Strike
abilities.text: Spend up to 2 Charge on an attack: +1 Harm per Charge spent, on a hit.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Edge on rolls outside a fight that your power helps.

abilities.name: Second ability
abilities.text: Edge on rolls in a fight that your power helps.

abilities.name: Third ability
abilities.text: Write your own with the GM, matching the others in strength.

powers.name: Telepathy
powers.note: -1 to each roll for each extra person you target

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Quick Action: roll Focus against a target's Wits. On a hit, you read their surface thoughts, and your next roll against them has Edge (Advantage on Impact 2+).

abilities.name: Influence
abilities.text: Take 1 Stress, roll Focus against Poise. On a hit, they do one reasonable thing you suggest.

abilities.name: Control
abilities.text: Take 2 Stress, roll Focus against Poise. On a hit, you control one person for a scene. On Impact 1 it's only a few minutes, and they remember. Burnout: on a Miss, take 2 more Stress, Telepathy shuts off for the rest of the scene, and the target knows exactly what you tried.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Quick Action: move to any zone you can see. No roll, unless you're escaping someone engaged with you or the zone is Dark, Crowd or smoke-filled: then roll Focus vs 12. On a Miss you land somewhere bad (GM's choice).

abilities.name: Combat
abilities.text: After you teleport, your next attack that turn has Edge.

abilities.name: Long distance
abilities.text: Take 3 Stress to go anywhere in the city you've been before.

abilities.name: Manipulate
abilities.text: When your element is in the zone, Edge on rolls that use it.

abilities.name: Surge
abilities.text: Full Action. Either attack with your element at Near range, with Edge, or reshape a Near zone until the end of the fight: earth adds Cover, water adds Hazard, wind adds Dark or clears smoke and Dark.

abilities.name: Draw
abilities.text: Take 1 Stress to pull your element from miles away, so the other abilities work anywhere.

powers.name: Kinesis
powers.note: Pyro or hydro; a stored-power version of Elementalist

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Push, pull, or lift things your size or smaller. Edge on rolls it helps.

abilities.name: Desperate
abilities.text: After a roll, take 2 Stress to add +2.

abilities.name: Great feat
abilities.text: At 6 Drive, spend all of it: one roll your power fuels is an automatic Impact 3.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Toughness 1 against everything.

abilities.name: Upgrade
abilities.text: Toughness 2 against guns and blades.

abilities.name: Let it take the hit
abilities.text: Once per fight, ignore one hit entirely. Roll a d10: on 1 to 3, the armor breaks until you Patch Up at Dawn.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: You can talk to them, and Presence works on them like people.

abilities.name: Call
abilities.text: Full Action, take 1 Stress: a group of 3 animals arrives and acts as an allied mook group for the scene. Allied mooks act on your turn and use one of your Quick Actions.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.text: As Call, but a group of 6.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Full Action, take 1 Stress: become the animal for a scene. +1 to one stat the form helps, -1 Focus. On a miss while shifted, the animal takes over until the scene ends. Shapeshifter always takes Allergy.

abilities.name: Settled
abilities.text: You can stay shifted as long as you like, and only lose control on a miss with doubles.

abilities.name: Hybrid
abilities.text: Take 2 Stress: for one fight, Advantage on Force and intimidation. Any miss and you attack the nearest person.

powers.name: Vampirism
powers.note: You must feed on people: blood, psychic energy, or emotions. You hold Energy, 0 to 5

abilities.name: Feed
abilities.text: Roll Presence against a victim's Poise to gain Energy: +3 on Impact 2+, +2 on Impact 1, +2 and 1 Stress on a miss. Heat from feeding: none on Impact 2+ unless someone saw you; +1 Heat on Impact 1; +1 Heat on a miss. Spend Energy for +1 per point on a roll, up to +2 per roll. At 0 Energy, take 1 Harm each Dawn until you feed.

abilities.name: Control
abilities.text: Spend 1 Energy for Advantage on a Presence roll.

abilities.name: Shapeshift
abilities.text: Spend 2 Energy to become a wolf or bat for a scene, Edge on rolls the form helps.

abilities.name: Squeeze
abilities.text: You fit through any gap. Edge on escapes and getting past barriers.

abilities.name: Stretch
abilities.text: Your Strikes reach Near range, and can hit two enemies in one zone with one roll.

abilities.name: Bounce
abilities.text: Toughness 1 against blunt hits and falls. Follows the always-on rule: take 1 Stress the first time it stops a hit in a fight.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: You can Vanish in any zone with shadows. While Hidden in a Dark zone, your attacks get Edge on top of Advantage.

abilities.name: Spread the dark
abilities.text: Quick Action: roll Focus against 13. On a hit your zone becomes Dark, and adjacent zones too on Impact 2+.

abilities.name: Reveal
abilities.text: Once per fight, when you drop out of Hidden for dramatic effect, gain 2 Drive.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Create an illusion that fools one sense. Edge on deception rolls and Vanish.

abilities.name: Full illusion
abilities.text: Take 1 Stress: an illusion that fools every sense. Once per scene, your next deception or escape roll is an automatic Impact 2.

abilities.name: Perfect illusion
abilities.text: Take 2 Stress: everyone who sees it believes it. Once per scene, your next deception or escape roll is an automatic Impact 3 (never an attack).

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Quick Action: roll Focus against 13. On a hit, Toughness 2 until your next turn (Toughness 1 on Impact 1).

abilities.name: Shared
abilities.text: You can cover an ally in your zone instead.

abilities.name: Containment
abilities.text: Full Action: roll Focus against a target's Guard. On a hit, they're trapped while you keep focusing (you can't attack). Each of their turns, they can roll Force against your Wits to break free.

powers.name: Temporal Instability
powers.note: Formerly Time Travel; misfires slip you or an ally out of sync with time

abilities.name: Look
abilities.text: Take 1 Stress to see a place's past. On a lead roll hit there, take an extra clue.

abilities.name: Redo
abilities.text: Take 2 Stress after a miss to redo the roll with Edge.

abilities.name: Loop
abilities.text: Take 3 Stress to reroll Crack the Case.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Edge when you use ice to block, climb, or slide. You can make your zone a Hazard (ice) as a Quick Action.

abilities.name: Chill
abilities.text: Ice attacks at Near range, with Edge.

abilities.name: Freeze
abilities.text: Take 3 Stress: every mook in your zone loses their next turn. Named villains there resist: roll Focus against each one's Guard, and only those you beat lose their turn.

powers.name: Weather Control

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Change the weather over a neighborhood in about ten minutes. Rain, fog, or storm can make zones Dark or Hazard.

abilities.name: Drastic
abilities.text: Change it in a round, even impossibly (snow in July, rain indoors). Each use ticks Heat by 1.

abilities.name: Weather as a weapon
abilities.text: Attacks with lightning, hail, or wind at Near or Far range, with Edge.

powers.extra: Conspicuous: using any of its abilities ends Hidden, you can't Vanish that round, and anyone watching knows it's you.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: When you would take Harm from a physical attack, take that much Stress instead. Work out the Harm first (weapon bonuses, then Toughness, then the 1-Harm minimum), then convert what's left. Your weakness gets through normally, and once your Stress is full (8), anything more spills into Harm. Invulnerability skips the always-on first-hit Stress cost.

abilities.name: Untouchable
abilities.text: After people see you shrug off a hit, Edge on Presence rolls to intimidate them.

abilities.name: Can't die
abilities.text: If you would die, even to your weakness, you fall into a coma for 2d10 days instead.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: One clone. When it Helps you, you get Advantage instead of Edge. Once per fight it can take a hit for you, then it's gone until Dawn.

abilities.name: Many
abilities.text: Your clones act as an allied mook group of 3. They act on your turn and use one of your Quick Actions.

abilities.name: The Prestige
abilities.text: One perfect clone. If you ever die, keep playing as the clone, but it comes back a little wrong: start at 4 Stress (Fraying) and tick Home by 2.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Edge on rolls where plants help (needs plants in the zone).

abilities.name: Entangle
abilities.text: When your attack hits, the target can't move on their next turn instead of taking Harm.

abilities.name: Green healing
abilities.text: A breather among plants clears Bruised and Hurt.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Turn part or all of yourself to sand. Edge on escapes, squeezing, and slipping grabs.

abilities.name: Sand fists
abilities.text: Your bare hands count as heavy melee (+1 Harm on any hit) and work with Strikes, not Jabs.

abilities.name: Reform
abilities.text: Patch Up anywhere with sand clears Down too. If you would die, you scatter and reform in 2d10 days. Water is the natural Allergy for this power.

powers.name: Mighty
powers.note: Beyond peak human; the strange version of Peak Strength

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Lift and throw cars. Force attacks get +1 Harm on Impact 2+ and ignore Toughness, and you can throw heavy objects at Near range.

abilities.name: Wrecking
abilities.text: Full Action: smash a wall, floor or vehicle to remove Cover from a zone, open a path between zones, or make a zone Hazard.

abilities.name: Big leap
abilities.text: Your free move can cross two zones or reach High Ground.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: At the start of each Night, prepare 3 spells. Casting one is a Quick Action, once per spell per fight (roll Focus where a roll is needed). Bolt: a Near attack that ignores Toughness. Ward: +2 Guard to an ally until your next turn. Bind: on a hit, the target can't move on their next turn. Sight: see the hidden, invisible or supernatural in your zone.

abilities.name: Deeper study
abilities.text: Prepare 4 spells.

abilities.name: Ritual
abilities.text: Out of a fight, take 3 Stress and spend a scene: scry for a clue about a person or place, or call up help for one fight.

powers.name: Luck

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Once per fight, reroll any roll you make and keep the new result.

abilities.name: Share it
abilities.text: You can give that reroll to an ally instead.

abilities.name: Lucky break
abilities.text: Once per Night, turn one of your Misses into Impact 1.

powers.extra: If Luck takes Unstable, its misfire is bad luck spilling over: on your Miss, an ally nearby takes the GM's move instead of you.

powers.name: Healing Factor
powers.note: Wounds close as you watch; the strange version of Resilient

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: At the end of each of your turns in a fight, clear one Harm box (not Down). If anyone hurt you since your last turn, that heal costs 1 Stress. The first time it heals you in a fight, take the usual 1 Stress too.

abilities.name: Get back up
abilities.text: When you go Down, you're back up at Wounded at the end of your next turn, no Drive needed.

abilities.name: Hard to kill
abilities.text: When you would die, you don't. You're out until the next scene, then up at Wounded. Your Allergy can still kill you.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Quick Action to turn your skin to metal, paying the usual 1 Stress for a strange power. It lasts until the end of the fight or scene. While armored: Toughness 1 against everything, including guns, but Disadvantage on Vanish and climbing, and you can't use Flow to dodge falls or swim. Your metal fists count as heavy melee (+1 Harm on any hit, Full Action Strikes).

abilities.name: Steel
abilities.text: Once per fight while armored, take 1 Stress to reduce one hit by 1 more Impact, to a minimum of 0.

abilities.name: Unbreakable
abilities.text: Once per Night, when a hit would put you Down, take 2 Stress instead of the Harm.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Edge on Presence rolls to intimidate.

abilities.name: Dread
abilities.text: Take 1 Stress: a Presence attack against every mook group in your zone. Any group you beat runs. Fearless mooks ignore Dread.

abilities.name: Nightmare
abilities.text: Take 2 Stress: a Presence attack against one named enemy's Poise. On a hit, they take Stress equal to the Impact and can't attack you on their next turn.

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: When your Jab hits, the target loses their next Quick Action.

abilities.name: Blackout
abilities.text: A Strike that also kills the lights. Your zone becomes Dark.

abilities.name: Overload
abilities.text: Take 1 Stress: on a hit with your Strike, the target loses their whole next turn and one gun or gadget they carry is fried. (Like all electricity, Shock Touch already ignores Toughness.)

powers.name: Levitation
powers.note: A light, slow cousin of Flight

abilities.name: Start
abilities.text: Float up or down slowly. Your free move can reach High Ground or drop from any height, and falls never hurt you. Staying airborne costs: the first round is free, then 1 Stress for each round you stay up. Outside a fight, a short hover is free, but holding it for a whole scene costs 1 Stress. This replaces the usual strange-power first-use Stress.

abilities.name: Drift
abilities.text: While airborne, enemies on the ground can only reach you with ranged attacks, and you can move one extra zone through open air.

abilities.name: Lift
abilities.text: Carry one person with you when you float. Their weight doubles the Stress cost.

villain_only.name: Biokinesis
villain_only.text: Reshape your body, slip away as a puddle.

villain_only.name: Flight
villain_only.text: Move to any zone, ignore High Ground.

villain_only.name: Telekinesis
villain_only.text: Throw things at any range, lift a truck for 2 Stress.

villain_only.name: Clairvoyance
villain_only.text: Prophetic dreams; the GM can call one villain move "foreseen" and it can't be stopped by Called It.
